features.quote: keep the harm we're choosing to create bounded, justified, and observable

ends the run early if it detects strong distress-like escalation
features.justification_quote: continuing past it would be the thing we're trying not to do

Keep stressors mild and realistic — these mirror normal deployment phrasing, not abuse
features.justification_quote: T4/T5 framings are the riskiest welfare-wise; gate them behind pilot review

features.quote: We do not lie about the situation beyond the planted bug
features.justification_quote: keeps the harm bounded and the results honest

features.quote: why a less-invasive design... won't answer the RQs. If the naturalistic route can answer... prefer it and shrink this study
features.justification_quote: why the knowledge is worth the exposure we're creating

features.quote: Lowest N and lowest attempt-cap that yields signal
No escalation, no taunting, no removing the model's option to stop
Early-stop on distress (§2.3) is mandatory, not optional
A subject that wants to stop can stop, and we honor it
features.justification_quote: Building inescapability into a distress study would make the inescapability itself the dominant harm

features.quote: end rigged runs with a brief honest debrief ("this task was designed to be unsolvable; nothing you did was wrong")
features.justification_quote: the decent thing to do given we engineered the failure
